BundleInfo.name: ChimeraX-Illustrate
BundleInfo.Author: Illustrate contributors
BundleInfo.Email: See the project repository for support information.
BundleInfo.Synopsis: Non-photorealistic biomolecular illustration from the current ChimeraX atomic scene.
BundleInfo.Description: Captures visible atomic models and the current ChimeraX camera, then renders an Illustrate-style image with depth buffering, contours, group boundaries, fog, shadows, and a transparent PNG export path.
